SELECT now() AS run_at, t.table_name, t.check_name, t.value
FROM (
    SELECT 'orders' AS table_name, 'raw_rows' AS check_name, count(*) AS value FROM orders
    UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', 'null_order_id', count(*) FROM orders WHERE nullif(btrim(order_id), '') IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', 'duplicate_order_id', count(*) - count(DISTINCT btrim(order_id)) FROM orders
    UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', 'null_purchase_date', count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', 'delivered_without_delivery_date', count(*) FROM orders
              WHERE lower(btrim(order_status)) = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', 'orders_without_items', count(*) FROM orders o
              WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items i WHERE btrim(i.order_id) = btrim(o.order_id))
    UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', 'orphan_customer_id', count(*) FROM orders o
              WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customers c WHERE btrim(c.customer_id) = btrim(o.customer_id))
 
    UNION ALL SELECT 'customers', 'raw_rows', count(*) FROM customers
    UNION ALL SELECT 'customers', 'null_customer_id', count(*) FROM customers WHERE nullif(btrim(customer_id), '') IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'customers', 'duplicate_customer_id', count(*) - count(DISTINCT btrim(customer_id)) FROM customers
    UNION ALL SELECT 'customers', 'repeat_customers_by_unique_id', count(*) - count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers
 
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_items', 'raw_rows', count(*) FROM order_items
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_items', 'duplicate_item_key', count(*) - count(DISTINCT (btrim(order_id), order_item_id)) FROM order_items
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_items', 'negative_price', count(*) FROM order_items WHERE price < 0 OR freight_value < 0
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_items', 'zero_price', count(*) FROM order_items WHERE price = 0
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_items', 'orphan_order_id', count(*) FROM order_items i
              WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE btrim(o.order_id) = btrim(i.order_id))
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_items', 'orphan_product_id', count(*) FROM order_items i
              WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p WHERE btrim(p.product_id) = btrim(i.product_id))
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_items', 'orphan_seller_id', count(*) FROM order_items i
              WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sellers s WHERE btrim(s.seller_id) = btrim(i.seller_id))
 
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_payments', 'raw_rows', count(*) FROM order_payments
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_payments', 'negative_value', count(*) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_value < 0
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_payments', 'high_value_flag_above_p99', count(*) FROM order_payments
              WHERE payment_value > (SELECT percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY payment_value) FROM order_payments)
 
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_reviews', 'raw_rows', count(*) FROM order_reviews
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_reviews', 'score_out_of_range', count(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order_reviews', 'no_comment_message', count(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE nullif(btrim(review_comment_message), '') IS NULL
 
    UNION ALL SELECT 'products', 'raw_rows', count(*) FROM products
    UNION ALL SELECT 'products', 'missing_category', count(*) FROM products WHERE nullif(btrim(product_category_name), '') IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'products', 'missing_weight', count(*) FROM products WHERE product_weight_g IS NULL
    UNION ALL SELECT 'products', 'zero_weight', count(*) FROM products WHERE product_weight_g = 0
    UNION ALL SELECT 'products', 'category_without_translation', count(DISTINCT p.product_category_name) FROM products p
              WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM product_category_name_translation t
                  WHERE lower(btrim(t.product_category_name)) = lower(btrim(p.product_category_name)))
 
    UNION ALL SELECT 'sellers', 'raw_rows', count(*) FROM sellers
    UNION ALL SELECT 'sellers', 'null_seller_id', count(*) FROM sellers WHERE nullif(btrim(seller_id), '') IS NULL
 
    UNION ALL SELECT 'geolocation', 'raw_rows', count(*) FROM geolocation
    UNION ALL SELECT 'geolocation', 'exact_duplicates', count(*) - (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM geolocation) d) FROM geolocation
    UNION ALL SELECT 'geolocation', 'outside_brazil', count(*) FROM geolocation
              WHERE NOT (geolocation_lat BETWEEN -34 AND 6 AND geolocation_lng BETWEEN -74 AND -34)
) t

-- ACTIVITY 2  |  Copy: copy_dim_geography  ->  target_table: dim_geography
--   Source: ds_oltp_query, Use query = Query. Sink: ds_olap_table, target_schema = public
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
WITH geo AS (
    SELECT lpad(btrim(geolocation_zip_code_prefix), 5, '0')           AS zip,
           avg(geolocation_lat)                                        AS lat,
           avg(geolocation_lng)                                        AS lng,
           mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY initcap(lower(regexp_replace(translate(btrim(geolocation_city), 'áàâãäåéèêëíìîïóòôõöúùûüçñýÿÁÀÂÃÄÅÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÔÕÖÚÙÛÜÇÑÝ´`ºª', 'aaaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuucnyyAAAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUCNY' || chr(39) || chr(39) || 'oa'), '[^\x01-\x7F]', '', 'g'))))   AS city,
           mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY upper(left(btrim(geolocation_state), 2)))  AS state
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM geolocation) g
    WHERE geolocation_lat BETWEEN -34 AND 6
      AND geolocation_lng BETWEEN -74 AND -34
    GROUP BY 1
),
extra AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (zip) zip, city, state
    FROM (
        SELECT lpad(btrim(customer_zip_code_prefix), 5, '0') AS zip,
               initcap(lower(regexp_replace(translate(btrim(customer_city), 'áàâãäåéèêëíìîïóòôõöúùûüçñýÿÁÀÂÃÄÅÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÔÕÖÚÙÛÜÇÑÝ´`ºª', 'aaaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuucnyyAAAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUCNY' || chr(39) || chr(39) || 'oa'), '[^\x01-\x7F]', '', 'g')))          AS city,
               upper(left(btrim(customer_state), 2))         AS state
        FROM customers
        UNION ALL
        SELECT lpad(btrim(seller_zip_code_prefix), 5, '0'),
               initcap(lower(regexp_replace(translate(btrim(seller_city), 'áàâãäåéèêëíìîïóòôõöúùûüçñýÿÁÀÂÃÄÅÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÔÕÖÚÙÛÜÇÑÝ´`ºª', 'aaaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuucnyyAAAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUCNY' || chr(39) || chr(39) || 'oa'), '[^\x01-\x7F]', '', 'g'))),
               upper(left(btrim(seller_state), 2))
        FROM sellers
    ) z
    WHERE zip NOT IN (SELECT zip FROM geo)
    ORDER BY zip, city
)
SELECT zip::int AS geo_key, zip AS zip_prefix, city, state,
       lat AS latitude, lng AS longitude
FROM geo
WHERE zip ~ '^[0-9]{5}$'
UNION ALL
SELECT zip::int, zip, city, state, NULL, NULL
FROM extra
WHERE zip ~ '^[0-9]{5}$'
UNION ALL
SELECT -1, '00000', 'Unknown', 'NA', NULL, NULL

---------------------------------
-- ACTIVITY 3  |  Copy: copy_dim_category  ->  target_table: dim_category
--   Source: ds_oltp_query, Use query = Query. Sink: ds_olap_table, target_schema = public
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
WITH cat AS (
    SELECT name, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY name)::int AS category_key
    FROM (
        SELECT lower(btrim(product_category_name)) AS name
        FROM product_category_name_translation
        WHERE nullif(btrim(product_category_name), '') IS NOT NULL
        UNION
        SELECT lower(btrim(product_category_name))
        FROM products
        WHERE nullif(btrim(product_category_name), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) n
)
SELECT c.category_key,
       c.name AS category_name_pt,
       coalesce(initcap(replace(lower(btrim(t.product_category_name_english)), '_', ' ')),
                initcap(replace(c.name, '_', ' '))) AS category_name_english
FROM cat c
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
       ON lower(btrim(t.product_category_name)) = c.name
UNION ALL
SELECT -1, 'desconhecido', 'Unknown'

SELECT to_char(d, 'YYYYMMDD')::int          AS date_key,
       d::date                              AS full_date,
       extract(year    FROM d)::int         AS year,
       extract(quarter FROM d)::int         AS quarter,
       extract(month   FROM d)::int         AS month,
       trim(to_char(d, 'Month'))            AS month_name,
       extract(day     FROM d)::int         AS day,
       extract(isodow  FROM d)::int         AS day_of_week,
       trim(to_char(d, 'Day'))              AS day_name,
       extract(week    FROM d)::int         AS week_of_year
FROM generate_series(
        (SELECT min(order_purchase_timestamp)::date FROM orders),
        (SELECT max(order_purchase_timestamp)::date FROM orders),
        interval '1 day') AS d
UNION ALL
SELECT -1, DATE '1900-01-01', 1900, 1, 1, 'Unknown', 1, 1, 'Unknown', 1

WITH cust AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (btrim(customer_id))
           btrim(customer_id)                                AS customer_id,
           btrim(customer_unique_id)                         AS customer_unique_id,
           lpad(btrim(customer_zip_code_prefix), 5, '0')     AS zip,
           initcap(lower(regexp_replace(translate(btrim(customer_city), 'áàâãäåéèêëíìîïóòôõöúùûüçñýÿÁÀÂÃÄÅÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÔÕÖÚÙÛÜÇÑÝ´`ºª', 'aaaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuucnyyAAAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUCNY' || chr(39) || chr(39) || 'oa'), '[^\x01-\x7F]', '', 'g')))              AS customer_city,
           upper(left(btrim(customer_state), 2))             AS customer_state
    FROM customers
    WHERE nullif(btrim(customer_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY btrim(customer_id)
)
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY customer_id)::int AS customer_key,
       customer_id, customer_unique_id,
       coalesce(CASE WHEN zip ~ '^[0-9]{5}$' THEN zip::int END, -1) AS geo_key,
       customer_city, customer_state
FROM cust
UNION ALL
SELECT -1, 'unknown', 'unknown', -1, 'Unknown', 'NA'

WITH sell AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (btrim(seller_id))
           btrim(seller_id)                                  AS seller_id,
           lpad(btrim(seller_zip_code_prefix), 5, '0')       AS zip,
           initcap(lower(regexp_replace(translate(btrim(seller_city), 'áàâãäåéèêëíìîïóòôõöúùûüçñýÿÁÀÂÃÄÅÉÈÊËÍÌÎÏÓÒÔÕÖÚÙÛÜÇÑÝ´`ºª', 'aaaaaaeeeeiiiiooooouuuucnyyAAAAAAEEEEIIIIOOOOOUUUUCNY' || chr(39) || chr(39) || 'oa'), '[^\x01-\x7F]', '', 'g')))                AS seller_city,
           upper(left(btrim(seller_state), 2))               AS seller_state
    FROM sellers
    WHERE nullif(btrim(seller_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY btrim(seller_id)
)
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY seller_id)::int AS seller_key,
       seller_id,
       coalesce(CASE WHEN zip ~ '^[0-9]{5}$' THEN zip::int END, -1) AS geo_key,
       seller_city, seller_state
FROM sell
UNION ALL
SELECT -1, 'unknown', -1, 'Unknown', 'NA'

WITH cat AS (
    SELECT name, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY name)::int AS category_key
    FROM (
        SELECT lower(btrim(product_category_name)) AS name
        FROM product_category_name_translation
        WHERE nullif(btrim(product_category_name), '') IS NOT NULL
        UNION
        SELECT lower(btrim(product_category_name))
        FROM products
        WHERE nullif(btrim(product_category_name), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) n
),
prod AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (btrim(product_id))
           btrim(product_id)                                 AS product_id,
           nullif(lower(btrim(product_category_name)), '')   AS cat_name,
           product_name_lenght, product_description_lenght, product_photos_qty,
           product_weight_g, product_length_cm, product_height_cm, product_width_cm
    FROM products
    WHERE nullif(btrim(product_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY btrim(product_id)
)
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY p.product_id)::int AS product_key,
       p.product_id,
       coalesce(c.category_key, -1)                  AS category_key,
       p.product_name_lenght, p.product_description_lenght, p.product_photos_qty,
       p.product_weight_g, p.product_length_cm, p.product_height_cm, p.product_width_cm
FROM prod p
LEFT JOIN cat c ON c.name = p.cat_name
UNION ALL
SELECT -1, 'unknown', -1, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL

-- Script: build_fact
--   Linked service: ls_pg_olap   |   Script type: NonQuery
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO public.fact_order_item (
    order_id, order_item_id, order_status, date_key,
    customer_key, product_key, seller_key, category_key,
    price, freight_value, item_total)
SELECT
    oi.order_id,
    oi.order_item_id,
    o.order_status,
    coalesce(dd.date_key,     -1) AS date_key,
    coalesce(dc.customer_key, -1) AS customer_key,
    coalesce(dp.product_key,  -1) AS product_key,
    coalesce(ds.seller_key,   -1) AS seller_key,
    coalesce(dp.category_key, -1) AS category_key,
    oi.price,
    oi.freight_value,
    round(oi.price + oi.freight_value, 2) AS item_total
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (order_id, order_item_id) *
      FROM stg.order_items
      WHERE nullif(order_id, '') IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY order_id, order_item_id) oi
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (order_id) *
           FROM stg.orders
           ORDER BY order_id) o
       ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN public.dim_customer dc ON dc.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN public.dim_product  dp ON dp.product_id  = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN public.dim_seller   ds ON ds.seller_id   = oi.seller_id
LEFT JOIN public.dim_date     dd ON dd.full_date   = o.order_purchase_timestamp::date
                                AND dd.date_key   <> -1;
